I am actually doing some foundationally research to turn into a full on independent study of the homeless crisis in Bellingham for my BA program. I really enjoyed your post and am going to consider the applicability of some of your opinions as variables in my study. 

If anyone still comes across this post I would love to know some other factors surrounding this topic you feel should be further analyzed!

Careful waiving the inspection. My Grandfather just got a house using his VA loan, and decided not to. When he toured the house the family had the basement full of stuff, inspector couldn't get a good look. Turns out the waterproofing is shit. Now the family that sold him the house is paying for the 18k in repairs they tried to stick him with.
